svg.text: Study 008 — The Edges You Don’t Draw
lost and found edges: let the light dissolve what the pen doesn’t need to say · seeded 8008
II. the gap the eye closes
five clean gaps on straight runs —
the bottle is still a bottle
the lit shoulder dissolves — hatch and
What it taught: a contour is not a wire around the drawing — it is a rumor of an edge, loud where the form turns
into shadow and silent where light dissolves it. The eye trusts the rumor and finishes the drawing itself; ink every edge
equally and the form goes flat.
